title: Joseph's Brothers Go to Egypt

questions.question: Why did Jacob send his sons to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:2: "I have heard that there is grain for sale in Egypt. Go down and buy grain for us there."

questions.question: Which brother did Jacob not send to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:4: "But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph's brother, with his brothers."

questions.question: What did the brothers do when they came before Joseph?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:6: "Joseph's brothers came and bowed themselves before him with their faces to the ground."

questions.question: Did the brothers recognize Joseph?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:8: "Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him."

questions.question: What did Joseph accuse his brothers of being?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:9: "He said to them, 'You are spies; you have come to see the nakedness of the land.'"

questions.question: Which brother did Joseph keep as a hostage?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:24: "He took Simeon from them and bound him before their eyes."

questions.question: What did the brothers find in their sacks?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:27-28: Each man found his money in the mouth of his sack.

questions.question: What did Joseph demand they bring next time?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:20: "Bring your youngest brother to me. So your words will be verified."

questions.question: What did the brothers say to each other about their guilt?
options: They were being punished for what they did to Joseph
questions.correctAnswer: They were being punished for what they did to Joseph
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:21: "Then they said to one another, 'In truth we are guilty concerning our brother.'"

questions.question: What was Jacob's reaction to their request to take Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:38: "My son shall not go down with you...if harm should happen to him."

questions.question: What did Reuben offer Jacob to guarantee Benjamin's safety?
options: The lives of his own two sons
questions.correctAnswer: The lives of his own two sons
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:37: "Kill my two sons if I do not bring him back to you."

questions.question: How many days did Joseph keep his brothers in custody?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:17: "He put them all together in custody for three days."

questions.question: What did Joseph do after hearing his brothers speak of their guilt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:24: "Then he turned away from them and wept."

questions.question: How many brothers went to Egypt the first time?
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:3: "So ten of Joseph's brothers went down to buy grain in Egypt."

questions.question: What did Reuben remind his brothers about?
options: That he had warned them not to harm Joseph
questions.correctAnswer: That he had warned them not to harm Joseph
questions.explanation: Genesis 42:22: "Reuben answered them, 'Did I not tell you not to sin against the boy? But you did not listen.'"

key_verse_text: Joseph's brothers came and bowed themselves before him with their faces to the ground.
